pages.name: Bookskito
pages.text: It beats its covers like wings.

The bookskito flies on its covers, and settles flat against shelves of books to rest. Sometimes it drops to the floor instead, covers propped open like a tent.$(br2)It bites back if angered. Wear gold and it will not bite.

$(item)Diet$()$(br)Bookskitoes eat what books are made of: paper, leather, rabbit hide, ink sacs and glow ink sacs, and any dye. Books themselves, blank or written, are a feast.$(br2)Fed in pairs, they have young that take the look of either parent.
